name: RC-B10-0102/2025 – § 11 – Am 4
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of violence in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo
part_text: 11. Urges the Commission and the Council to immediately suspend the EU-Rwanda MoU on sustainable raw materials value chains until Rwanda proves it is ceasing its interference and its exportation of minerals mined from M23-controlled areas; calls on all actors to increase transparency and to effectively ban the entry of all blood minerals into the EU; calls for the EU to put in place a trade embargo on all minerals from Rwanda, until it is clear where the minerals come from and until the RDF and the rebel group supported by Rwanda withdraw definitively from the territory of the DRC;
